(()=>{ const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Design'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return 'clicked Design'; } return 'Design button not found'; })()

(()=>{ const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('Architectural workspace')); if (btn) { btn.click(); return 'clicked Architectural workspace'; } return 'Architectural workspace not found'; })()

(()=>{ const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.arch-tabs button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('Drawing sheets')); if (btn) { btn.click(); return 'clicked Drawing sheets'; } return 'Drawing sheets tab not found'; })()
(()=>{ const d = document.querySelector('.arch-issue-set'); if (d) d.open = true; return 'opened issue set'; })()

(()=>{ const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.arch-issue-set button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('Select all sheets')); if (btn) { btn.click(); return 'clicked Select all sheets'; } return 'Select all sheets btn not found'; })()

(()=>{ const input = document.querySelector('.arch-issue-purpose-input'); if (!input) return 'no purpose input'; input.focus(); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(input, 'For tender'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return 'purpose set to ' + input.value; })()

(()=>{ const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.arch-issue-set button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('Review issue')); if (btn) { btn.click(); return 'clicked Review issue'; } return 'Review issue btn not found'; })()

(()=>{ const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.arch-sheet-review button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('Export issue PDF')); if (btn) { btn.click(); return 'clicked Export issue PDF'; } return 'Export btn not found'; })()

(()=>{ const issueSet = document.querySelector('.arch-issue-set'); if (issueSet) issueSet.open = false; const hist = document.querySelector('.arch-issue-history-details'); if (hist) hist.open = true; document.querySelector('.arch-issue-history-control')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); return 'arranged view for Rev A'; })()
(()=>{ const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.arch-issue-history-card')); return JSON.stringify({ count: cards.length, firstCardText: cards[0]?.innerText.replace(/\n/g, ' ') }); })()

(()=>{ const input = document.querySelector('input.arch-revision-input'); if (!input) return 'revision input not found'; input.focus(); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(input, 'B'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); input.blur(); return 'revision B committed: ' + input.value; })()

(()=>{ const d = document.querySelector('.arch-issue-set'); if (d) d.open = true; const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.arch-issue-set button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('Select all sheets')); if (btn) btn.click(); const input = document.querySelector('.arch-issue-purpose-input'); if (!input) return 'no purpose input'; input.focus(); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(input, 'For construction'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return 'purpose set to ' + input.value; })()

(()=>{ const issueSet = document.querySelector('.arch-issue-set'); if (issueSet) issueSet.open = false; const hist = document.querySelector('.arch-issue-history-details'); if (hist) hist.open = true; document.querySelector('.arch-issue-history-control')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.arch-issue-history-card')).map(c => c.innerText.replace(/\n/g, ' ')); return JSON.stringify(cards); })()

(()=>{ const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.arch-issue-history-card')); const revACard = cards.find(c => c.textContent.includes('Rev A')); const inspectBtn = Array.from(revACard?.querySelectorAll('button') || []).find(b => b.textContent.includes('Inspect layout')); if (inspectBtn) { inspectBtn.click(); return 'clicked Inspect layout on Rev A'; } return 'Inspect layout btn not found'; })()
